note: A warm-up (DayShape2): part 3 of the voice warm-up run, picked by its kind and never for a path step. The same leaps out from Do and back, going down from the Do one scale above the low one, so a beginner starts in the middle of the staff and not at its top.

exercise.title: Out from Do and back, going down
exercise.why: A leap down and back up asks your voice to drop without losing the note it left, so coming home to the same Do each time trains the way back up.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff, the five lines of music. Find the second {{1}} on the staff, eight notes above the low {{1}}, and tap it to hear it. Sing that {{1}}, then {{7}} under it, then {{1}} again. Then go one note further down each time: {{1}} {{6}} {{1}}, then {{1}} {{5}} {{1}}, and on down to the low {{1}}. Sing along on the note names.
Each time you come back up, listen for your {{1}} landing where it started.
In another key every note moves, and each leap still starts and ends on {{1}}.
_Don't reach for high notes: start on the {{1}} in the middle of the staff, not the one at the top._
